hypotheses.H1: Explicit changed friction/units/calibration belongs to system identity; identical policy source cannot justify physical evidence reuse.
hypotheses.H2: At matched control-step budgets and fixed finite-population decision error, decision-directed acquisition may reduce missed beneficial changes relative to coverage and static short-circuit checks.

scope: New physical/measurement sanity check, not a reopened owner-cost campaign; all cases builder-exposed. No general superiority, independent human replication, H3 or H4 claim.
system: 1 kg block, constant nonnegative horizontal force; Coulomb friction under continuing positive force, zero initial speed; no collision, stick-slip transition, braking, arbitrary robot or hardware model.
execution: dt=.01 s; exact-kinematic constant-acceleration step recurrence with float arithmetic; independent rational closed-form reference; numeric measurement allowance 1e-12 m.
measurement: Final displacement relative to reset origin, rounded to declared quantum; absolute quantization error at most quantum/2 plus numeric allowance. Binary failure means endpoint error greater than .01 m. Ambiguous intervals remain [0,1].
qualification: Uniform eight-condition finite population; candidate-minus-reference binary loss. Missing paired outcome [-1,1]. Delta bounds sum cell bounds / 8. Noninferior U<=0; contradicted L>0; else unresolved. Superiority only U<0. Equivalence separately [-1/8,+1/8]. No i.i.d./population CI or lifetime claim.
independence: Selector sees only probe id, weight, cost, observed loss intervals and budget. It never receives physical case parameters, fault labels, raw states or exact reference outcomes. Separate exact reference implementation imports neither simulator nor selector; runs after frozen comparison. Builder knows authored cases; this is implementation diversity, not an independent human evaluator.
reference: Closed-form rational solution for all development and distinct confirmation tasks; full paired contingency and exact delta. Also reconstruct instrument-limited identification bounds without treating oracle truth as available evidence.
mandatory_confirmation: Four distinct origins, distances and durations. Reserve and charge 244 control steps before diagnosis for every arm. A proposed approval requires all four new pairs; confirmation bounds must support NI separately. No confirmation on reject/unresolved. This is deterministic re-execution on new conditions, not random statistical independence.
acquisition: Maximin elimination of differently labelled finite completions per control step conditional on unambiguous cell measurement. Ambiguous actual results never inherit this prospective premise as evidence. Exact enumeration, no supplied prior.
baselines: All share the same observations, dependencies, loss bounds and confirmation obligations. Coverage orders population weight per control-step cost; static prioritizes shortest affected check; uncertainty orders weighted remaining range; exhaustive continues every affordable condition. Random repeats describe ordering variability, not additional independent cases.
reuse: No prior candidate rollouts admitted. The same known reference and frozen source are available to every arm; reference rollouts are re-executed and fully charged. H1 SDK controls separately test unchanged input reuse, changed physical input and missing dependency.
gate: Every accepted finite bound must contain independent exact delta; measurement ambiguities must not be converted to zero. Any false admission is a failed gate. Comparative value may be negative. No expansion on a tie.
predeclared_mechanisms: sensor resolution insufficient for 10 mm task tolerance
